title_yt: 3 GTA 6 mistakes. Number 3 is the worst #Shorts
title_fb: 3 GTA 6 mistakes. Number 3 is the worst
hook: Three G T A 6 mistakes. Number three is the worst.
open_loop: Line 1 promises three mistakes and teases that number three is the worst; the fake pre-order site and malware gremlin pay it off in lines 5-7, then the lesson and A/B.
payoff: Three traps with consequences: $20 more for Ultimate, pay later bills chasing you (LendingTree: 47% of pay later users paid late), a fake pre-order site with malware. Lesson: pay in full, use official stores.

lines.text: Three G T A 6 mistakes. Number three is the worst.
lines.visual: SCENE 1 (frame 0): Benny in hoodie, backwards cap, gold shades, pumped, cash in hand; a plain-text store sign 'GTA 6' behind him. Headline '3 MISTAKES' already on screen. Snap-zoom on 'G'. SCENE 2 (on 'Number'): a big red '3' pulses, stamp 'WORST' on 'worst', Benny gulps.
lines.say: Three G, T, A, six mistakes. Number three is the worst.

lines.text: One: Ultimate costs you $20 more than Standard.
lines.say: One: Ultimate costs you twenty dollars more than Standard.
lines.visual: SCENE 3: Number '1' pops. Benny slaps cash, smug. A generic gold 'ULTIMATE' box with a small 'EXTRAS' tag (no art, no logo, no item names). SCENE 4 (on 'twenty'): '+$20 MORE' slams with a clink; GAG: the cash in Benny's hand vanishes with a thud and his smirk wobbles; a plain 'STANDARD' box pops on 'Standard'.

lines.text: Two: you pay later. Bills chase you.
lines.visual: SCENE 5: Number '2' pops. Benny taps a phone, grins at a sticker 'PAY LATER' (no game shown). SCENE 6 (on 'Bills'): 'BILL' slips pop up closer and closer as Benny runs in panic; thud sfx on 'you'.

lines.text: LendingTree says 47% of pay later users paid late.
lines.say: LendingTree says forty-seven percent of pay later users paid late.
lines.visual: SCENE 7: small badge 'LENDINGTREE' with a grid of 100 grey icons. On 'forty-seven': flash, snap-zoom, 47 of the 100 icons snap to red at once, headline '47%' slams (ding), Benny gasps (shock). On 'paid late': headline 'PAID LATE' (only after the LENDINGTREE badge has gone; max 3 text items).

lines.text: Three: you click a fake pre-order site.
lines.visual: SCENE 8: Number '3' pops. Benny in a dark room taps a phone (no console); a generic shady sticker 'FAKE PRE-ORDER' (no logo); a hooded stranger grins from the screen edge; Benny drools, clicks.

lines.text: Dozens of fake sites exist. Some spread malware.
lines.visual: SCENE 9 (on 'Dozens'): grid of many identical blank fake-site windows pops up, headline 'DOZENS OF FAKE SITES'. SCENE 10 (on 'Some'): red tint, the hooded stranger grins, Benny's phone gets hit; stamp 'MALWARE' on 'malware' (buzz, shake).
SCENE 11: Benny hugs his phone, shocked then broke face; speech bubble 'Not my device!' (quip).

lines.text: Pay in full. Use official stores.
lines.visual: SCENE 12: green tint, Benny calm with shades back on, ticks a check list 'PAY IN FULL' and 'OFFICIAL STORES'.

lines.text: Ultimate, or keep $20? Comment A or B.
lines.say: Ultimate, or keep twenty dollars? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: SCENE 13 (on 'Ultimate'): Benny smug, row 'A: ULTIMATE'. On 'keep': Benny holds cash, happy, row 'B: KEEP $20'. Benny points at viewer on 'Comment'. No footer (rows only).

facts_used.claim: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99; difference $20.00 (voice and screen use $20 only). Ultimate adds in-game extras (vehicles, weapons, storefronts, a mission); shown only as a neutral 'EXTRAS' tag.
LendingTree 2026 survey: 47% of buy-now-pay-later users paid late in the past year (general BNPL fact, not about GTA 6 buyers).

NordVPN found dozens of malicious sites impersonating Rockstar/game storefronts (fake pre-orders, beta access, malware installers). Platform of the malware not stated, so the video says 'your device'.

math_check: 99.99-79.99=20.00 = $20. 47 of 100 icons red = 47%. 'Dozens' not a number. Items 1/2/3 = 3 mistakes.

upload.description:
Number 3 could wreck your device, not just your wallet.
Ultimate, or keep $20? Comment A or B.
Ultimate costs $20 more than Standard. LendingTree says 47% of pay later users paid late. Dozens of fake sites exist, and some spread malware (NordVPN research). Pay in full and use official stores.
Not financial advice. Sources: LendingTree, NordVPN via CyberInsider.
